title: Preferred tempos
summary: He likes medium tempos where people can understand the music.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: What kind of tempos do you like to play? We're talking about...

Well, I'll tell you. Talking about music, you know. For fast, fast music, it's alright, but, uh... It doesn't do anything to me. I like a medium tempo, where, you know, people can understand the music.

You... Well, you play a lot of fast tunes and there's a lot of noise, but, I mean, it's like... You can't understand what the hell they're playing, see? No. You know what I mean? Yeah. You can make a lot of noise, but, I mean, when you play a good tune, or a good medium tempo, that's it, see?
